text: Wrap up is where the charts get finished. It's completely separate from checkout, where the family pays and we plan follow-ups. Neither one waits on the other, and you can even sign later, after the visit.
When the exam is charted, click Wrap up visit.
Each pet has a card. Four of four means all four SOAP sections have notes.
Click the pet's name to open them.
Subjective, objective, assessment, and plan. Read them over, and fix anything right here. It saves when you click away.
Click the name again to close it.
Under that are the pet's problems. To add one, type it in,
then choose Acute or Chronic. This ear infection is acute. It goes on her problem list when the chart is signed.
Medications work the same way, right below.
And if someone should check in with the family, add a callback here.
Next is the client recap. Scout writes it from the charts. Read it like the family will, and change anything you'd say differently.
This family asked us not to email them, so the address stays blank.
So click Don't email,
say why,
and record it.
Three checks have to pass before you can sign: the client recap, doses and prescriptions, and weights.
One click signs and locks both charts. Only a licensed veterinarian can sign a full SOAP.
Changed your mind about the recap? You can still write one after signing.
Need to add something later? Open the SOAP, and use Write addendum. It's dated and added below, and the signed chart stays as it was.

For techs: on a full SOAP, the sign button is greyed out for you. Get the recap and doses ready, then hand it to the doctor. And if a chart is still open a day later, Scout gives the doctor a task to finish it.
